review.scope: Complete exact-span ownership and source-order checks. Visual and English comparison resolves the duplicate-labelled boundary only; this is not a complete wording, heading or translation review.

duplicateReferenceEvidence.pageNumbering: One-based PDF page numbers, not printed page labels.
duplicateReferenceEvidence.observation: The first chain is Malik/Nafi/Abdullah ibn Umar with twenty-seven degrees. The second is al-Layth/Ibn al-Had/Abdullah ibn Khabbab/Abu Said al-Khudri with twenty-five degrees. Both prints show fresh chains and separate reports in that order. Bewley identifies the second as 619b. The following Abu Hurayra report remains 620. Comparison wording and abbreviations still require individual content review; matching does not certify identical text.

implementation.policy: Canonical positive integer references retain their type. Explicit lower-case single-letter suffixes are separate references. Sorting uses numeric base followed by suffix; no parseInt coercion, fractional surrogate, automatic deduplication or downstream number shift. A changed reference requires exact source-label mapping, the correct comparison book, pinned English record evidence and both printed witnesses.
implementation.schemaBoundary: Any mapped inventory with a suffix uses schema 3. Existing integer-only inventories remain schema 2 and reproduce unchanged. The current reader build refuses schema 3; this is deliberate until complete reference support and data migration are implemented and tested.

verification.browserCheck: No runtime or public reader asset changed; existing deployed browser checks remain applicable. No new iPhone or content-accuracy acceptance claimed.

reader.translationStatus: AI-assisted working English; independent review pending.

nextPhase.decision: Make explicit source references distinct from list positions throughout the reader before admitting a suffixed record. Keep existing numeric references and saved data stable; use the recorded 619b identity rather than a fabricated numeric substitute.

requiredWork.requirement: One canonical validation/parsing policy for numeric and suffixed references. Validate identity, uniqueness and catalog order. Batch completeness must use source order rather than integer ranges; a range crossing 619 must include 619b.

Open 619 and 619b independently, preserve suffix in every route/data action and search by exact reference in both worker and fallback. Previous/next follows catalog order; sources and return links preserve identity.

Round-trip bookmarks, read markers, scroll positions, last place and session cursor without numeric coercion. Preserve all legacy backups. Verify migration and rollback behavior so an older reader cannot erase suffixed data.

Count complete records in catalog order, including 619b, without arithmetic on references. Preserve a finite current session during free browsing. Audio availability must remain explicit; source work does not create or approve narration.

Retain exact source labels and mapping notices, unique source-note anchors, complete offline paths and verified pack hashes. Test direct source links and restore flows offline around 619 → 619b → 620.

nextPhase.acceptance: Meaningful fixtures must cover two independent records 619 and 619b, followed by 620, across publication, loading, direct navigation, source links, exact search, sessions, backup migration and offline reload. Current 577 source objects must remain unchanged. Then continue individual Arabic/English review and admit complete chapters from Adhan 578 onward.
nextPhase.unfinished: All Adhan wording, translation and chapter reviews; reader suffix support; full Bukhari coverage; English chapter introductions; additional reviewed Cedar audio; independent scholarly and spoken-word review.
